protocol_type: Streaming layered Ethernet PHY at 800 Gb/s. The MAC carries IEEE 802.3 Clause-4 frames (unchanged); the PCS encodes + FEC-protects + distributes the stream across multiple PCS lanes with alignment markers; the PMA/PMD carry PAM4 symbols across 8x100G or 4x200G electrical/optical lanes. There is no opcode / command protocol on the data path. Management is a separate Clause-45 MDIO two-cycle address-then-data protocol.

channels.name: 800GMII (logical RS interface)
channels.description: Reconciliation-Sublayer interface carrying the 800 Gb/s MAC byte stream into the PCS. Logical at 800G — no exposed wide parallel pin bus.

channels.name: PCS lanes
channels.description: The encoded + FEC-protected stream is distributed across multiple PCS lanes, each carrying 64b/66b blocks plus periodic alignment markers for receiver deskew/reorder.

channels.name: 800GAUI-8 electrical lanes
channels.description: 8 differential TX + 8 differential RX pairs, each 100 Gb/s PAM4 at 106.25 GBd. The 4x200G variant uses 800GAUI-4 (4 lanes of 200 Gb/s).

channels.name: PMD medium lanes
channels.description: DR8/SR8/VR8 = 8 parallel fibers; 2xFR4 = 2x4 CWDM wavelengths on single-mode fiber. PAM4 line modulation.

channels.name: MDC / MDIO (Clause 45)
channels.description: Serial management bus; MDC ≤ 2.5 MHz (or faster per vendor), MDIO bidirectional three-state. Two-cycle address-then-data per Clause 45 (PMA/PMD/PCS/AN MMDs).

packet_classes.purpose: Carries user data between MACs; Clause-4 frame format preserved.
subtypes: Untagged data frame (DA + SA + EtherType/Length + Payload + FCS, 64-1518 B)

packet_classes.purpose: Line-coding + FEC + lane-distribution units below the MAC (NOT MAC frames).
MMD-extended PHY register access via two-cycle address-then-data.
Electrical-lane equaliser adaptation + capability exchange before PCS lock.

mac_frame_format.destination_address: 6 octets (48 bits). I/G + U/L bits as in base 802.3.
mac_frame_format.payload: 46-1500 octets (42-1500 in a VLAN-tagged frame). Zero-padded if shorter.
mac_frame_format.pad: 0-46 octets of 0x00 to reach the 64-byte minimum.
mac_frame_format.fcs: 4 octets, IEEE 802.3 CRC-32, polynomial 0x04C11DB7. UNCHANGED at 800G; orthogonal to the PCS RS-FEC.
mac_frame_format.note: The 800 Gb/s MAC frame is byte-for-byte identical to every prior Ethernet speed — only the rate and the underlying PCS/PMA/PMD differ.

mdio_clause22_frame.PRE: 32 contiguous logic-1 bits on MDIO with 32 corresponding MDC cycles. May be suppressed if both ends support preamble suppression (BMSR bit 1.6).
mdio_clause22_frame.ST: <01> — start of frame, ensures transitions from default-1 line state.
mdio_clause22_frame.PHYAD: 5 bits, MSB first. 32 unique addresses; PHYAD 00000 always responded to by a single-PHY connection.
mdio_clause22_frame.REGAD: 5 bits, MSB first. 32 registers; register 0 = BMCR, register 1 = BMSR, register 2/3 = PHY ID, register 4 = ANAR, register 5 = ANLPAR, register 6 = ANER, register 9 = 1000BASE-T Control, register 10 = 1000BASE-T Status, register 15 = Extended Status.
mdio_clause22_frame.TA: 2 bits. Read: bit-0 = high-impedance (both sides), bit-1 = 0 driven by PHY. Write: <10> driven by STA.
mdio_clause22_frame.DATA: 16 bits. First bit on the wire = bit 15 of the register being accessed.

mdio_clause45_frame.DEVAD: 5-bit MMD Device Address: 1 = PMA/PMD, 3 = PCS, 7 = Auto-Negotiation.
mdio_clause45_frame.DATA: 16 bits. Address cycle writes the indirect register address; data cycle accesses it.

transaction_classes_split.interface: Out-of-band Fast Link Pulse on MDI before data signaling begins

valid_ready_handshake_rules: The 800G data path is a continuous stream — there is no per-beat valid/ready handshake at the PMD; flow control is end-to-end via PAUSE / PFC frames at the MAC.
Receiver achieves PCS block lock (64b/66b sync) then alignment-marker lock (per-PCS-lane deskew + reorder) before delivering reassembled blocks to the MAC.
RS-FEC corrects up to 15 symbol errors per (544,514) codeword; uncorrectable codewords are marked and the spanning 66b blocks flagged.
MDIO Clause 45: each transaction is an Address cycle (OP=00) followed by a Data cycle (OP=01/11/10) on the same DEVAD.
Link training (electrical lanes) converges the FFE/DFE coefficients before the PCS attempts block lock.

frame_format.mac_data_frame: Preamble(7×0x55) + SFD(0xD5) + DA(6 B) + SA(6 B) + Type/Length(2 B) + Payload(46-1500 B) + Pad(0-46 B) + FCS(4 B CRC-32).
frame_format.vlan_tagged_frame: Preamble + SFD + DA(6 B) + SA(6 B) + TPID(0x8100, 2 B) + TCI(2 B = PCP[3] + DEI[1] + VID[12]) + EtherType/Length(2 B) + Payload + FCS — max 1522 B.
frame_format.pause_frame: DA = 01:80:C2:00:00:01, EtherType = 0x8808, MAC Control Opcode = 0x0001, Pause Quanta (16 b), pad to 64 B, FCS.
frame_format.mdio_c22_frame: PRE(32) + ST(01) + OP(10/01) + PHYAD(5) + REGAD(5) + TA(2) + DATA(16) — total 64 MDC cycles (32 PRE + 32 frame).
frame_format.mdio_c45_address: PRE(32) + ST(00) + OP(00) + PRTAD(5) + DEVAD(5) + TA(10) + ADDR(16) — 64 MDC cycles.
frame_format.mdio_c45_data: PRE(32) + ST(00) + OP(01/11/10) + PRTAD(5) + DEVAD(5) + TA + DATA(16) — 64 MDC cycles, must follow an Address cycle on the same DEVAD.

pcs_pipeline.step_1_64b66b: MAC stream blocked into 64b/66b (2-bit sync header + 64-bit payload).
pcs_pipeline.step_2_transcode: 256b/257b transcoding reduces the coding overhead before FEC.
pcs_pipeline.step_3_scramble: Self-synchronous scrambling for DC balance + transition density.
pcs_pipeline.step_4_rs_fec: RS-FEC(544,514) over GF(2^10): 514 message + 30 parity = 544 ten-bit symbols; corrects up to 15 symbol errors/codeword.
pcs_pipeline.step_5_distribute: Round-robin distribution across PCS lanes with periodic per-lane alignment markers.
pcs_pipeline.step_6_pma_pmd: PMA bit-muxes PCS lanes onto physical lanes; PMD PAM4-modulates each lane at 106.25 GBd.
